metadata.trace_retention: Full traces retained for LN midday; trajectory summaries retained for all cases. Full raw profiles remain in the run output directory.

method: Five paired runs per case, sequential; alternate solver order and seeded shuffled case order. Warm all cases first; GC.gc() before each pair, outside timing. Native fresh process per solve, excludes process launch/input read/hash/output encoding; Julia persistent process, excludes input read/output encoding. Detailed profiles and trajectories collected separately from timed repeats. Timers overlap: factorization includes first back solve; numeric_factor_s is the backend numeric factor timer. Solver formulations, scaling, and initialization are not forced identical.
